metadata.basis: OpenStreetMap power plant tagged as nuclear, reduced to a point.
metadata.note: This is a crowd-mapped facility list, not a regulator inventory, and it covers nuclear power plants only. It is not a radiation measurement and must not be read as evidence of a release, a test or an accident. Plants tagged disused are included and labelled. Individual reactor units are not listed.
metadata.extraction: Coordinates taken from the Overpass response; nodes as published and areas as the centroid OpenStreetMap publishes for them. No coordinate created or moved.
